name: crossMoDA Challenge
description: The purpose of this study is to apply and evaluate out-of-the-box deep learning frameworks for the crossMoDA challenge. We use the CUT model, a model for unpaired image-to-image translation based on patchwise contrastive learning and adversarial learning, for domain adaptation from contrast-enhanced T1 MR to high-resolution T2 MR. As data augmentation, we generate additional images with vestibular schwannomas with lower signal intensity. For the segmentation task, we use the nnU-Net framework. Our final submission achieved mean Dice scores of 0.8299 in the validation phase and 0.8253 in the test phase. Our method ranked 3rd in the crossMoDA challenge.
reputation: A challenge benchmark used in the medical imaging community for cross-modality domain adaptation and segmentation of vestibular schwannoma.
notes: Challenge-style benchmark with a relatively small, specialized dataset; performance is reported on validation/test splits and may vary by submission protocol.
